method: Independent direct linguistic and exact-base renderer review. All three translations retained after checking the complete selector, not inferred from English alone. Model-reviewed, not native-certified.

rows.context_and_review_note: Retained iri (edge/border) plus ghas (only): a short nominal label appropriate to the contour of a shape, not an instruction to crop canvas edges. Exact-base ClassicPaintActivity.kt:789–790 offers this at shapeStyle index 0 for rectangle, polygon, ellipse, rounded rectangle, heart, star and arrow. PaintDocument.kt:272–282 draws foreground STROKE only and does not clear or fill the interior. No transparency promise is introduced; the previous interior pixels remain.

Retained aktur s yan uklu (fill with one colour): nominal filling plus preposition s and attached-state colour uklu after yan. This describes a uniform selected-colour fill, not hardness or opacity. At selector index 1, PaintDocument.kt:274–277 draws the shape path with foreground FILL; :279 skips STROKE. In this three-way selector its contrast with Border only and Fill + border is adequate. It does not claim that background/foreground must differ, and does not refer to bucket fill or whole-document flood fill. Antialiasing and any selected colour alpha remain renderer properties, not contradicted by this label.

Retained Fill + border: iri intentionally means the outline around the shape rather than a separate straight line. Selector index 2 uses background FILL at PaintDocument.kt:276 and foreground STROKE at :280. This preserves both operations without falsely promising two distinct colours, a transparent interior, or flood fill. Its P2 tier remains unchanged: companion of the two P1 choices, not promoted to P1.
